mapper.select: SELECT ta.id AS tripId, ta.start_date AS startDate, ta.end_date AS endDate, ta.location, cp.user_id AS reviewedUserId, u.username, u.image_path AS imagePath FROM trip_article ta LEFT JOIN chat_room cr ON ta.id = cr.trip_article_id LEFT JOIN chat_participants cp ON cr.id = cp.chat_room_id AND cp.status = 'COMPLETED' LEFT JOIN users u ON cp.user_id = u.id WHERE ta.id = #{tripId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trip_reviews (user_id, trip_article_id, rating, title, content, is_public, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{tripId}, #{rating}, #{title}, #{content}, #{isPublic}, NOW())
INSERT INTO user_by_user_review (user_id, reviewed_user_id, rating) VALUES (#{reviewId}, #{reviewedUserId}, #{userRating})
mapper.select: SELECT tr.id, tr.rating, tr.title, tr.content, tr.created_at AS createdAt, u.nickname, COALESCE(u.image_path,'/image/member.png') AS reviewerImagePath, ri.image_path AS imagePath FROM trip_reviews tr JOIN users u ON tr.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN trip_reviews_image ri ON ri.trip_reviews_id = tr.id WHERE trip_article_id = #{tripId} ORDER BY tr.created_at DESC
